plain: A decision that is unwise as public policy.

webster.text: Inexpedience; unsuitableness to the end proposed; bad policy; defect of wisdom; a word applied to private as well as public affairs.

example.quote: He dwelt on the injustice and impolicy of leaving N.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 16, 1787
